confirmed_source_facts.locator: Overview, PDF page 4; Procedure steps 19-21, PDF page 19
confirmed_source_facts.fact: Modified oligo-dT capture beads retain poly(A)+ mRNA; magnetic separation permits transfer of the gDNA-containing supernatant to a new plate.
The new plate keeps the same orientation and the address of each cell is tracked. This preserves pairing between the separated fractions; the preview alone does not establish this.
Bead wash supernatants and the final tip wash are transferred to the corresponding gDNA collection well. These are retained DNA-branch transfers, not disposal.
RT mix is added to the bead-containing RNA plate, and bead-captured mRNA proceeds to reverse transcription. The separated DNA plate proceeds independently.
